10 open-source SoundCloud projects built by reverse engineering

Open-source projects that exist because someone reverse engineered SoundCloud music streaming. 7 of 10 had a commit in the last 12 months. Most-starred: nuclear, streamrip, scdl, muffon, SoundCloud-Desktop.
